tagline: All photos and videos taken by Karson Shin.
bio: i’m a photographer drawn to capturing the little details, fleeting moments, and unique perspectives that make everyday life feel memorable. from travel and landscapes to street photography and candid moments, i use my camera to document the world as i see it. this is a collection of images, memories, and places worth remembering.
